parameters.name: vehicle_types
parameters.description: Finite set of vehicle types, indexed by i in the set

parameters.name: total_travelers
parameters.description: Total number of travelers to transport

parameters.name: seating_capacity
parameters.description: Seating capacity of each vehicle type i

parameters.name: rental_cost
parameters.description: Rental cost of one vehicle of each type i

parameters.name: fleet_limit
parameters.description: Available fleet limit for each vehicle type i

variables.name: vehicles_rented
variables.description: Number of vehicles rented of each type i

variables.name: total_rental_cost
variables.description: Total rental cost of the selected fleet

constraints.name: nonnegative_vehicle_capacity
constraints.description: Vehicle seating capacity is nonnegative for each vehicle type

constraints.name: nonnegative_rental_cost
constraints.description: Rental cost is nonnegative for each vehicle type

constraints.name: nonnegative_fleet_limit
constraints.description: Fleet limit is nonnegative for each vehicle type

constraints.name: integer_vehicle_decisions
constraints.description: Number of vehicles rented of each type is a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: driver_limit
constraints.description: Total number of rented vehicles cannot exceed the number of available drivers; each rented vehicle requires one driver

constraints.name: fleet_availability_limit
constraints.description: Rented vehicles of each type cannot exceed the available fleet limit for that type

constraints.name: capacity_requirement
constraints.description: Total seating capacity must be sufficient to transport all travelers

constraints.name: cost_definition
constraints.description: Total rental cost is determined by the selected vehicle quantities and their rental costs

objectives.name: minimize_total_rental_cost
objectives.description: Minimize the total rental cost of the selected fleet while meeting traveler demand and resource limits

final_objective.description: Minimize the total rental cost of the selected fleet while meeting traveler demand and resource limits.
